dedupe_keys.name: repository of nbs guidance material conexus

description: The NbS Guidance Repository is a collection of guides, handbooks, manuals, toolboxes and other guidance materials on nature-based solutions written for non-academic actors. The materials cover the governance, planning, implementation, management and monitoring of nature-based solutions and related approaches such as green infrastructure, urban forestry and ecosystem-based adaptation, and address issues such as climate change adaptation, biodiversity and environmental justice. It was compiled by Martina van Lierop at the Technical University of Munich in the Horizon 2020 project CONEXUS, which worked with European and Latin American cities, so it reaches beyond the Europe-centred platforms. The repository is downloadable free as one Excel database from Zenodo (August 2024) under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it catalogues documents, not data or models, links may age, and the selection reflects the project's scope. It supports finding design and planning guidance for green and blue infrastructure measures used in adaptation scenarios; related records are the Oppla repository and the ACT on NBS tools catalogue.
